parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Screen-space horizontal gaze: negative left, positive right.
parameters.constraints: Finite number in [-1, 1]. Zero is centered.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Screen-space vertical gaze: negative up, positive down.
parameters.constraints: Finite number in [-1, 1]. Zero is centered.

actions.doc: Replace the animated eye gaze target. Completion means the target was accepted, not that animation ended. Independent of expression and physical equipment.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: JSON pose overlay for one observed camera frame.
parameters.constraints: At most 3000 UTF-8 bytes. sequence, timestamp, rotation 0...3, and people (0...6 arrays of 17 COCO joints). Each joint is [x,y,confidence], coordinates in 1/10000 image units, confidence 0...1000.

tools.doc: Replace the camera skeleton overlay atomically. Empty people clears previous skeletons. Coordinates describe the upright unmirrored inference image. Does not control physical equipment. Completes without returning data or feeding a ToolResult to the Agent.
